lang.description: BCP 47 code of this translation, for <html lang>.

dir.description: Text direction of this translation: ltr or rtl.

extDescription.message: Unofficial companion for Bingers: see your status on IMDb and TMDB, catch your next episode, and mark titles watched.

action_watched.description: Button: mark this movie as watched.

action_markEp.description: $1 is an episode code like S02E05.

action_track.description: $1 is a website, title or episode code.

report_failed.message: Couldn't send it. Check your connection and try again.

signin_body.message: Track episodes, see your status on IMDb and TMDB, and mark things watched from any tab.

signin_usePat.message: Use a personal access token instead

signin_planNote.message: API access needs the Bingers Legend or Icon plan.

upnext_empty.message: Nothing queued up. Find something in Search and follow it.

search_pickHint.message: Search for the show or movie that's playing.

search_tip.message: Tip: select text on any page, right-click, and choose “Search Bingers”.

search_linked.message: Got it. Cue will track this.

state_confirm.message: Marking it watched in a few seconds unless you skip

live_playerOn.message: Player turned on. Press play again if it doesn't pick it up.

live_notListed.message: $1 isn't on Cue's list of streaming sites yet.

live_offer.message: Mark what you watch here automatically?

np_changeEp.message: Wrong episode? Change the season and episode

np_reportHint.message: Send this site to the developer so Cue can learn it

ep_hintMove.message: Moves the watched mark to this episode.

ep_hintGuessed.message: Cue guessed this from your watch list.

ep_invalid.message: Enter a season (0 or more) and an episode (1 or more).

opt_tagline.message: An unofficial companion for your Bingers account. Not made by or affiliated with Bingers.

opt_languageHint.message: Language for Cue's menus, buttons and notices

opt_autoTrackToggle.message: Mark episodes and movies watched automatically while I watch

opt_confirm.message: Ask me before marking anything watched (marks it after 10 s unless I skip)

opt_skipPlatformsNote.message: YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Twitch, Kick, TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, X, Reddit, Rumble, Odysee, Bilibili, including their videos embedded in other pages. Turn off if you watch shows there.

opt_sitesHelp.message: To turn on a site, open it, click the Cue icon, then “Track”. Chrome asks you to approve each one, and Cue only runs on sites you approve. Your sites are listed below.

opt_allSitesNote.message: Chrome will ask once to let Cue run on every site. Cue still only reacts to long videos, so ads, trailers and short clips are ignored. You can skip a site from the Cue icon while you're on it.

opt_badge.message: Show my Bingers status and quick actions on title pages

opt_badgeNote.message: When this is on, the extension sends the IMDb or TMDB ID of the title page you're viewing to Bingers to look up your status. Nothing else from the page is read or sent.

opt_debugNote.message: Copy debug info and send it to the developer with a short description. It includes your settings, the sites you turned on and Cue's last few requests to Bingers (titles and statuses, no sign-in token). Nothing is sent until you paste it somewhere.

opt_debugCopied.message: Copied. Paste it into your message to the developer.

opt_oauthNote.message: Recommended. Opens a Bingers window where you approve access. No token to copy.

opt_orPat.message: or use a personal access token

opt_createToken.message: Create a token at $1. Pick “read + write” so you can mark things watched. The token is stored only in this browser.

opt_noSites.message: No sites yet. Open a site you watch on, click the Cue icon, then turn it on.

welcome_intro.message: Three quick steps and your episodes mark themselves watched in Bingers.

welcome_step2.message: Turn on the sites you watch on

welcome_step2Body.message: Chrome asks you to approve each site, and Cue only runs on the sites you approve. Pick some now, or later from the Cue icon while you're on any site.

welcome_step3Body.message: When you finish an episode or movie, Cue marks it watched in Bingers, with Undo. On IMDb and TMDB title pages you'll see your status too.

welcome_pin.message: Tip: pin Cue to the toolbar. Click the puzzle-piece icon, then the pin next to Cue for Bingers.

badge_minimiseHint.message: Cue for Bingers: click to minimise

icon_unknown.message: Cue: couldn't tell what's playing. Open to pick it

err_suggestionGone.message: That suggestion is no longer available.

menu_search.description: Right-click menu item. Chrome replaces %s with the selected text.

err_network.message: Couldn't reach Bingers. Check your connection.

err_signedOut.message: Your Bingers sign-in is no longer valid. Please sign in again.

err_readOnly.message: This sign-in can only read. Create a “read + write” token (or sign in again) to make changes.

err_plan.message: Your Bingers account doesn't have API access. It needs the Legend or Icon plan.

err_rateLimited.message: Bingers is rate-limiting requests. Try again in $1s.

err_authNetwork.message: Couldn't reach Bingers to sign in. Check your connection.

err_stateMismatch.message: Sign-in failed (state mismatch). Please try again.

err_notSignedIn.message: You're not signed in to Bingers.

err_expired.message: Your Bingers session expired. Please sign in again.

err_oauthNotSetup.message: Browser sign-in isn't set up in this build yet. Use a personal access token instead.

err_tokenFormat.message: That doesn't look like a Bingers token. It should start with bng_pat_.

err_tokenRejected.message: Bingers didn't accept that token. Check it was copied in full and hasn't been revoked.
